user_feedback: Photographic quality good; do not fix all three to green. Distinct theme color per banner, champagne gold fixed.
scope: Three color-only banner revisions, originals preserved, site/Figma unchanged
shared_prompt:
EDIT THE ATTACHED SINGLE BANNER using COLOR ART DIRECTION ONLY. Preserve its excellent realistic editorial photographic quality, beautiful adult model's exact face, identity, hair shape, expression, pose, hands, clothing design, props, face scale, panoramic 3:1 composition, full head framing and gold ribbon/filament geometry. Do not change the model, wardrobe silhouette, camera or object placement.
The user likes the photograph but rejects the three banners all using a fixed green theme. This image must now use the distinct palette specified below. KEEP CHAMPAGNE GOLD FIXED in metallic ribbons, edge filaments, coins, jewelry and small highlights. Other main colors should follow the new palette. Remove all remaining emerald/green color casts from chairs, tables, background, costume, wallet, gift ribbon or calendar panel, wherever present.
Keep the left 48% empty and calm for website heading/description/button, with a natural low-detail tonal blend, never text or a hard rectangular copy panel. Harmonize luminous gold banner effects at top/bottom edges with the new colors. Soft flattering natural skin remains warm-neutral, avoid colored cast on skin.
Output ONE independent text-free banner, panoramic 3:1 approx2172x724. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, new labels, no collage, no UI, no typography. Retain original meaningful objects, including any plain gold checkmark symbol. This is a coordinated banner family with shared photographic quality and champagne-gold effects but EACH BANNER HAS ITS OWN MAIN COLOR THEME.
